notes.title: Echo Generation: Midnight Edition is Out Now!
notes.content:
[h2]Dive into a world of turn-based adventure[/h2]

The time has come! Join the gang to investigate mysteries, battle monsters and uncover a conspiracy that transcends time in Echo Generation: Midnight Edition, available now on Steam with a 10% launch discount!

[previewyoutube=HcE4rhakhEQ;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Echo Generation: Midnight Edition now supports these languages:[/h3]
[list]
[*] French
[*] Spanish (European)
[*] Spanish (Latin American)
[*] German
[*] Italian
[*] Portuguese (Brazilian)
[*] Ukrainian
[*] Polish
[*] Chinese (Simplified)
[*] Chinese (Traditional)
[*] Japanese
[*] Korean
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38364907/cdd58d016710b1d22e71b70804e6b96781d9b70c.jpg[/img]

[h2]Drop us Review![/h2]
If you’ve played the game, don’t forget to leave us a review - it’s very much appreciated and helps us with visibility on Steam! ❤️


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1072300/Echo_Generation_Midnight_Edition/ 


[h3]Inputs & Controllers:[/h3]
Mouse and keyboard and full controller support is available for Xbox Controllers, DualShock Controllers (USB Only) and DualSense Controllers.


[h3]Note for Steam Deck players:[/h3]
For those are wondering, Echo Generation: Midnight Edition is working on the Steam Deck! If you encounter any issues, let us know in the comments or forum. Thank you!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38364907/93a576b28c9eca2f6bb02df19f0ab96001e9cf91.jpg[/img]


Enjoy the adventure! ⚔️

- The Coco Crew

notes.title: Steam Release Date Announced!
notes.content:
As revealed in the Guerilla Collective showcase, Echo Generation: Midnight Edition is coming to Steam June 19th, 2024. Thank you for your patience, it’s been quite a journey and we appreciate your support! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38364907/b8fe43fe941dadc68c1660074650dd7d05801eae.png[/img]

[b]What's New?[/b]
In addition to the base game, Midnight Edition includes quality of life improvements, bug fixes and more:
[list]
[*] Fast travel
[*] Quest tracker (Journal)
[*] Combat updates - Balancing and new status effects
[*] New camera controls - Tilt and zoom
[*] 12 new languages
[*] Controller support for Xbox and PlayStation
[*] Steam achievements
[/list]

[b]What's Next?[/b]
For now, don't forget to add the game to your wish list and follow us on socials:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1072300/Echo_Generation_Midnight_Edition/ 

[b]Discord: [/b]https://discord.gg/NZCaCaX27b 
[b]Twitter / X:[/b] https://x.com/cococucumberco 
[b]Press requests / content creators: [/b]info(at)cococucumber.co


Until next time,

- The Coco Crew

notes.title: Echo Generation - Steam Release TBA
notes.content:
Hi friends,

Some of you may have noticed that we announced the launch date for Echo Generation on Xbox and Windows PC and are wondering if the game will be released on Steam. 

Although we are an Xbox exclusive on initial release, we plan to bring Echo Generation to Steam at a later date (to be announced). 

[previewyoutube=l_2CPTovBGY;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]











[b]Play on Windows PC[/b]

If you would like to play the game on Windows PC, Echo Generation will be available on the Xbox App on [b]October 21st, 2021[/b]. It will also launch on Xbox Game Pass and Game Pass for PC on the same date.


[url=https://www.microsoft.com/store/productid/9nn7m263513g]Echo Generation Store Page - Xbox / Windows[/url]



[b]Play on Steam[/b]

If you would like to play on Steam, thanks for your patience. Don't forget to add Echo Generation to your [b]wishlist [/b]to be notified when it launches on Steam.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1072300/Echo_Generation/


Keep up with Echo Generation news and updates:

[url=http://www.twitter.com/cococucumberco]Follow on Twitter[/url]
[url=https://discord.gg/NZCaCaX27b]Echo Generation - Join Discord[/url]


Thanks for your support!

- The Coco Crew

notes.title: Echo Generation - Dev Stream
notes.content:
Hello crew!

We are bringing back the Echo Generation demo for the Steam Game Festival (Feb 3-9, 2021) and will be broadcasting a Dev Stream when the festival kicks off on Wednesday, Feb 3 at 1pm ET / 10am PT.

On the livestream will be Martin, Simone, Edgar and Vanessa from The Coco Crew to chat about game dev, character design, animation and more. 

Echo Generation - Dev Stream 
with The Coco Crew
Wednesday, 3 Feb at 1pm ET / 10am PT

Hope that you can join us for a good vibes only livestream. Please leave any questions for us in the chat!

And while you're at it, don't forget to add Echo Generation to your wishlist. Thanks!

- The Coco Crew
